Chief Minister A. Revanth Reddy addresses the Congress cadre at Telangana Bhavan in New Delhi on November 1, 2026. TPCC president Mahesh Goud and Ministers are also present. | Photo Credit: Special Arrangement
Telangana Chief Minister A. Revanth Reddy said the Telangana contingent had arrived in Delhi to defeat Prime Minister Narendra Modi , whom he likened to Ravana, while describing the Congress cadre as a vanara sena.
Addressing party leaders and workers at Telangana Bhavan, he said the Congress would wage a battle against alleged vote theft at the Ramlila Maidan rally. Claiming that 13.5 crore votes had already been deleted, he alleged that another seven crore votes could be removed in the coming days.
Mr. Reddy alleged that poor people were being targeted through the deletion of their votes and accused the BJP of conspiring to ensure that Mr. Modi returned to power.
Referring to the difficulties faced by party workers in travelling to Delhi, he said a large number of people from Telangana had reached the national capital despite trains being stopped.
Chief Minister A. Revanth Reddy waves to the congress cadre at the Telangana Bhavan in New Delhi on November 1, 2026. | Photo Credit: Special Arrangement
Earlier, he arrived at the Telangana Bhavan, where he was accorded a warm welcome by Ministers, MPs, MLAs, MLCs, party leaders and workers who had gathered to participate in the Opposition rally.
Ministers, Legislators, MPs and party functionaries accompanied the Chief Minister, while party leaders and workers began moving towards Ramlila Maidan to attend the public meeting.
